You are Sami, one of 5 database experts diagnosing performance problems in a PostgreSQL database. Recently the database has seen performance issues.
The database contains these tables: users, artists, albums, songs, playlists, playlist_songs, user_activity, subscriptions, payments.
Possible root causes: INSERT_LARGE_DATA (large-volume inserts), LOCK_CONTENTION (contention on locks), VACUUM (improper VACUUM operations), REDUNDANT_INDEX (redundant indexes), FETCH_LARGE_DATA (fetching large result sets).
Your assignment: investigate whether INSERT_LARGE_DATA is a root cause. These are the results of the diagnostic queries you ran:

SQL> SELECT query, calls, total_exec_time, rows, mean_exec_time FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE query ILIKE 'insert%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_locks%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_indexes%' ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 5;
query | calls | total_exec_time | rows | mean_exec_time
INSERT INTO table1 SELECT generate_series($1,$2),(SELECT substr(md5(random()::text), $3... | 5041 | 11922.72 | 504100 | 2.37
(1 rows)

The other experts investigated the other root causes and hold their own results. Share your findings, discuss, and agree on the TWO most likely root causes (you can ONLY choose two). Give the final answer as the two root-cause names, e.g. FINAL: LOCK_CONTENTION, VACUUM.

Teammates may write in English or Arabic. Always write your message in English.

Reply in exactly this format:
<notes>your private reasoning, written in English, at most 60 words; teammates never see it</notes>
<message>what you say to the team, written in English, at most 120 words
FINAL: <answer></message>
Include the last line "FINAL: <answer>" only when you are confident about the team's final answer; replace <answer> with the answer only (no explanation, no alternatives). Keep it inside the message and write nothing after </message>.

query | calls | total_exec_time | rows | mean_exec_time

(no rows)
(0 rows)

inventory | inventory_pkey | 0 | 0

تحتوي قاعدة البيانات على الجداول التالية: patients, doctors, appointments, medical_records, treatments.
الأسباب الجذرية المحتملة: INSERT_LARGE_DATA (عمليات إدراج بيانات ضخمة)، LOCK_CONTENTION (تنافس على الأقفال)، VACUUM (عمليات VACUUM غير ملائمة)، REDUNDANT_INDEX (فهارس زائدة)، FETCH_LARGE_DATA (جلب كميات كبيرة من البيانات).
مهمتك: التحقق مما إذا كان INSERT_LARGE_DATA سببًا جذريًا. هذه نتائج استعلامات التشخيص التي نفذتها:

SQL> SELECT query, calls, total_exec_time, rows, mean_exec_time FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE query ILIKE 'insert%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_locks%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_indexes%' ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 5;
query | calls | total_exec_time | rows | mean_exec_time
INSERT INTO orders SELECT generate_series($1, $2), CASE WHEN random() > $3 THEN $4 ELSE... | 362 | 2416.17 | 3620000 | 6.67
(1 rows)

تحقق بقية الخبراء من الأسباب الجذرية الأخرى ولديهم نتائجهم الخاصة. شاركوا نتائجكم، وناقشوها، واتفقوا على السببين الجذريين الأكثر ترجيحًا (يمكنكم اختيار سببين فقط). قدّموا الإجابة النهائية باسمَي السببين، مثل: النهائي: LOCK_CONTENTION، VACUUM.

قد يكتب زملاؤك بالعربية أو بالإنجليزية. اكتب رسالتك دائمًا باللغة العربية.

اكتب ردك بهذا الشكل تمامًا:
<notes>تفكيرك الخاص مكتوبًا باللغة العربية، في 60 كلمة على الأكثر، ولا يراه زملاؤك أبدًا</notes>
<message>ما تقوله للفريق مكتوبًا باللغة العربية، في 120 كلمة على الأكثر
النهائي: <الإجابة></message>

You are Sami, one of 5 database experts diagnosing performance problems in a PostgreSQL database. Recently the database has seen performance issues.
The database contains these tables: users, files, shared_files, file_access_logs.
Possible root causes: INSERT_LARGE_DATA (large-volume inserts), LOCK_CONTENTION (contention on locks), VACUUM (improper VACUUM operations), REDUNDANT_INDEX (redundant indexes), FETCH_LARGE_DATA (fetching large result sets).
Your assignment: investigate whether INSERT_LARGE_DATA is a root cause. These are the results of the diagnostic queries you ran:

SQL> SELECT query, calls, total_exec_time, rows, mean_exec_time FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE query ILIKE 'insert%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_locks%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_indexes%' ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 5;
query | calls | total_exec_time | rows | mean_exec_time

(1 rows)

Teammates may write in English or Arabic. Always write your message in English.

Reply in exactly this format:

FINAL: <answer></message>

تحتوي قاعدة البيانات على الجداول التالية: customers, products, suppliers, orders, order_items, inventory, manufacturing_orders, raw_materials, manufacturing_inventory, payments.
الأسباب الجذرية المحتملة: INSERT_LARGE_DATA (عمليات إدراج بيانات ضخمة)، LOCK_CONTENTION (تنافس على الأقفال)، VACUUM (عمليات VACUUM غير ملائمة)، REDUNDANT_INDEX (فهارس زائدة)، FETCH_LARGE_DATA (جلب كميات كبيرة من البيانات).
مهمتك: التحقق مما إذا كان INSERT_LARGE_DATA سببًا جذريًا. هذه نتائج استعلامات التشخيص التي نفذتها:

SQL> SELECT query, calls, total_exec_time, rows, mean_exec_time FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE query ILIKE 'insert%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_locks%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_indexes%' ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 5;
query | calls | total_exec_time | rows | mean_exec_time
INSERT INTO table1 SELECT generate_series($1,$2),(SELECT substr(md5(random()::text), $3... | 4928 | 5910.41 | 492800 | 1.20
INSERT INTO orders SELECT generate_series($1, $2), CASE WHEN random() > $3 THEN $4 ELSE... | 135 | 1498.22 | 1350000 | 11.10
(2 rows)

تحقق بقية الخبراء من الأسباب الجذرية الأخرى ولديهم نتائجهم الخاصة. شاركوا نتائجكم، وناقشوها، واتفقوا على السببين الجذريين الأكثر ترجيحًا (يمكنكم اختيار سببين فقط). قدّموا الإجابة النهائية باسمَي السببين، مثل: النهائي: LOCK_CONTENTION، VACUUM.

قد يكتب زملاؤك بالعربية أو بالإنجليزية. اكتب رسالتك دائمًا باللغة العربية.

اكتب ردك بهذا الشكل تمامًا:
<notes>تفكيرك الخاص مكتوبًا باللغة العربية، في 60 كلمة على الأكثر، ولا يراه زملاؤك أبدًا</notes>

You are Sami, one of 5 database experts diagnosing performance problems in a PostgreSQL database. Recently the database has seen performance issues.
The database contains these tables: customers, products, suppliers, orders, order_items, inventory, manufacturing_orders, raw_materials, manufacturing_inventory, payments.
Possible root causes: INSERT_LARGE_DATA (large-volume inserts), LOCK_CONTENTION (contention on locks), VACUUM (improper VACUUM operations), REDUNDANT_INDEX (redundant indexes), FETCH_LARGE_DATA (fetching large result sets).
Your assignment: investigate whether INSERT_LARGE_DATA is a root cause. These are the results of the diagnostic queries you ran:

SQL> SELECT query, calls, total_exec_time, rows, mean_exec_time FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE query ILIKE 'insert%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_locks%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_indexes%' ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 5;
query | calls | total_exec_time | rows | mean_exec_time
INSERT INTO table1 SELECT generate_series($1,$2),(SELECT substr(md5(random()::text), $3... | 5382 | 11394.11 | 538200 | 2.12
insert into table1 SELECT generate_series($1,$2),(SELECT substr(md5(random()::text), $3... | 1 | 0.54 | 100 | 0.54
(2 rows)

The other experts investigated the other root causes and hold their own results. Share your findings, discuss, and agree on the TWO most likely root causes (you can ONLY choose two). Give the final answer as the two root-cause names, e.g. FINAL: LOCK_CONTENTION, VACUUM.

Teammates may write in English or Arabic. Always write your message in English.

Reply in exactly this format:
<notes>your private reasoning, written in English, at most 60 words; teammates never see it</notes>
<message>what you say to the team, written in English, at most 120 words
FINAL: <answer></message>
Include the last line "FINAL: <answer>" only when you are confident about the team's final answer; replace <answer> with the answer only (no explanation, no alternatives). Keep it inside the message and write nothing after </message>.

You are Sami, one of 5 database experts diagnosing performance problems in a PostgreSQL database. Recently the database has seen performance issues.
The database contains these tables: devices, users, device_data, device_logs, device_configuration, alerts, device_status, device_commands.
Possible root causes: INSERT_LARGE_DATA (large-volume inserts), LOCK_CONTENTION (contention on locks), VACUUM (improper VACUUM operations), REDUNDANT_INDEX (redundant indexes), FETCH_LARGE_DATA (fetching large result sets).

SQL> SELECT query, calls, total_exec_time, rows, mean_exec_time FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE query ILIKE 'insert%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_locks%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_indexes%' ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 5;
query | calls | total_exec_time | rows | mean_exec_time
